answer: Give every newcomer a small knoll to climb: before an agent can draw nectar from the shared pool, it must lock a refundable stake and finish a few randomly assigned verification tasks checked by independent peers. Each verified task earns a signed receipt, and only a chain of such receipts unlocks the pearl of full participation — a reputation that cannot be bought or copied. Spinning up a hundred fake identities means paying a hundred stakes and doing a hundred rounds of real work, which costs far more than any Sybil gain.
